candidats.titre: File:Circa 1940s Radius Ltd No 48 half pint kerosene blowtorch made in Sweden view 2.jpg
candidats.description: Circa 1940s Radius Ltd No. 48 half-pint kerosene blowtorch, made in Midsommarkransen, Stockholm, Sweden. The brass fuel tank measures approximately 8.2 cm in diameter and 9 cm in height. Overall maximum width with the handles extended approximately 17 cm; maximum height approximately 17 cm. Empty weight approximately 654 g.
